results.title: Rocking Chair
results.description: Classic wooden rocking chair with a cushioned seat. Very comfortable for reading or sitting with friends. Seat cushion has some fading. Too big for my new place.

results.title: Wooden Nightstand
results.description: Small solid wood bedside table with one drawer and a shelf, sat next to my bed all year. Just the right height for a lamp, phone and water glass. Minor scuffs on one side.

results.title: Gray Rug
results.description: 5x7 gray shag area rug, soft underfoot. Cozy for a living room or bedroom. Vacuumed and spot-cleaned before listing. Rolled up for easy transport.

results.title: Blackout Curtains
results.description: Pair of thick charcoal blackout curtains that block almost all light. Great for bedrooms if you sleep late or work night shifts. Rod and hooks not included.

results.title: 32-inch TV
results.description: 32-inch 720p TV, good for a bedroom or small room. Picture is fine but the remote is missing a battery cover. Has HDMI and USB inputs.

results.title: Floor Lamp
results.description: Tall black arc floor lamp with a warm white shade. Bought last fall and barely used. Gives nice soft light for a living room or reading nook. Bulb included.

results.title: Compact Monitor
results.description: 22-inch 1080p computer monitor with HDMI and VGA. Useful for a study setup or second screen. Works perfectly, small mark on the bezel. Stand included.

results.title: Sheer Window Curtains
results.description: White sheer curtains that let sunlight through, good for privacy during the day only. Do not block light at night. A few small snags near the hem.

results.title: Television
results.description: 42-inch LED flat screen TV, 1080p with two HDMI ports. Remote included but no wall mount. Great for movies and gaming in a dorm or living room.

results.title: Blue Sofa
results.description: Large teal-blue three-seater sofa, very comfortable and fits 3 people. Much too big for a bedroom, it is a living room piece. Small stain on one arm. Needs two people to move.

results.title: Blue Silicone Kitchen Utensil Set
results.description: Set of 8 bright blue silicone cooking utensils for non-stick pans. Heat-resistant, used a few times. Good starter set for a first apartment kitchen.

results.title: Bookshelf
results.description: 5-tier black metal and wood bookshelf, holds a ton of textbooks. A couple of scratches on the top shelf but very sturdy. Pickup only, I can help carry it to your car.

results.title: Decorative Vase Set
results.description: Set of 3 ceramic vases in navy blue glaze, various heights. Still in packaging. Look great on a shelf, a mantel or a nightstand. Bought as decor but redecorated, so need to sell.

results.title: Sectional Sofa
results.description: Charcoal L-shaped sectional that seats 5 people, perfect for hosting movie nights. Bought new last year, no tears or stains. Pieces come apart for moving. Pickup only.

results.title: Blue and White Ceramic Planter
results.description: Hand-painted blue and white ceramic planter with drainage hole, 6 inches. Sits nicely on a windowsill, desk or nightstand. Never used, bought as a gift.

results.title: Patterned Wool Rug
results.description: Geometric patterned wool rug in cream and rust, 5x8. Makes a living room feel cozy and finished. Like new, from a smoke-free home. Rolled and ready to go.

results.title: Glass Coffee Table
results.description: Modern tempered glass coffee table with chrome legs. Looks sleek in a living room. No chips or scratches. Wipes clean easily but fingerprints show.

results.title: Bluetooth Speaker
results.description: Portable waterproof Bluetooth speaker, about 10 hours of battery. Loud enough for a dorm party or a room full of friends. Charger included.

results.title: Wall Art Set
results.description: Set of 3 minimalist abstract canvas prints in beige and sage green, 12x16 each. Easy decor for a living room wall. Hooks included. Tiny dent on one frame corner.

results.title: Modern Floor Lamp
results.description: Brand new modern brushed-brass floor lamp with a white drum shade, still in the box. Gift I did not need. Looks great in a living room corner.

results.title: Small Area Rug
results.description: Beige 3x5 accent rug, good for a bedside or entry. Some fraying on one edge and a faint stain in the middle. Still brightens up a floor.

results.title: Bookshelf Speaker Pair
results.description: Pair of wired bookshelf speakers with great clear sound for TV and music. Pairs well with a TV in a living room. Speaker wire included, no amplifier.

results.title: Microwave
results.description: 700W white microwave, heats food quickly and the turntable still spins fine. Used in our apartment kitchen. Clean inside, no smell. Pickup near campus.

results.title: Tall Shelving Unit
results.description: Tall 6-shelf white shelving unit for books, storage bins and plants. Very sturdy, assembled once and never moved. Perfect for a lot of storage in a small space.

results.title: Blue Throw Blanket
results.description: Soft light blue knit throw blanket, 50x60. Cozy at the foot of a bed or on a couch. Machine washed, no pills or stains.

results.title: Compact Loveseat
results.description: Gray two-seater loveseat, ideal for small apartments or a dorm lounge. Cushions are a bit flat and there is some pilling on the fabric. Cheap and comfortable enough for friends to sit and chat.

results.title: Oak Desk
results.description: Solid light oak writing desk, 48 inches wide with one drawer. Great for a study corner. Some ring marks from mugs, otherwise solid. Moving out May 10 so need gone.

results.title: Desk Lamp
results.description: Adjustable white LED desk lamp with 3 brightness levels and a USB port. Perfect for late-night studying. Works perfectly, cord is a little long.

results.title: 3-Drawer Dresser
results.description: Small 3-drawer wooden dresser in a light finish, good for clothes in a bedroom or dorm. Top has water marks and one handle is loose. Cheap and useful.

results.title: 55-inch Smart TV
results.description: 55-inch 4K smart TV with Netflix, YouTube and other apps built in. Great picture for movie nights in a living room. Hardly used, original remote and stand included. Moving abroad.

results.title: Framed Prints Bundle
results.description: Bundle of 4 black-framed botanical and city skyline prints. One frame has a cracked corner, the prints themselves are fine. Nice cheap way to decorate a living room or hallway.

results.title: Navy Table Lamp
results.description: Navy blue ceramic base table lamp with a white linen shade, 18 inches tall. Perfect size for a nightstand or bedside table. Works great, bulb included.

results.title: Rustic Wood Coffee Table
results.description: Reclaimed wood coffee table with an open lower shelf, rustic farmhouse style. Some natural knots and scuffs add character. Sturdy and heavy.

results.title: Dresser
results.description: White 4-drawer dresser, drawers glide smoothly. Used in my dorm bedroom for clothes. A few chips in the paint on the side. Bring a friend, it is heavy.

results.title: Countertop Microwave
results.description: Stainless steel countertop microwave, 900W with a defrost setting. Heats leftovers quickly. Used in a shared kitchen. Door handle is a little loose but works.

results.title: Coffee Table
results.description: Dark walnut coffee table with a lower shelf for magazines and remotes. Lived in my apartment living room for two years. Minor water ring on one corner.

results.title: Throw Pillow
results.description: Mustard yellow velvet throw pillow, 18x18 with insert included. Adds a pop of colour to a couch or bed. Smoke-free and pet-free home.

results.title: Small Bookshelf
results.description: Compact 3-shelf bookcase in walnut finish, 30 inches tall. Just right for a desk area or dorm room. Light scuffs on the sides. Easy to carry alone.

results.title: Desk
results.description: Simple white student desk with a small shelf underneath. Surface has scratches and one wobbly leg that needs a screw tightened. Works fine for a laptop and notes.

results.title: Linen Curtain Panels
results.description: Two light natural linen curtain panels, 84 inches long. Let in soft light and give a calm, airy look to a living room. Lightly ironed and like new.
